notes:
STATUS, a third entry on the home screen: what protel has told the tool — the in-house list, the arrival and departure reports and the moves window, each as captured, with its date, when it was taken, whether it was taken in and if not why, and the rows themselves. It asks protel nothing.

The automatic read no longer depends on a shortcut setting. The window watcher took its target from “Only while protel is in front”, so unticking that option silently switched the whole feed off. The target is its own line now, written whenever protel has been picked.

A report is stamped with protel's own date when the in-house list has been captured, the same clock the census uses, instead of the tool's night. The two agreed only while protel's date and the clock on the wall did.
